body.name: Conditional oracle upper-risk scale
body.construction:
Set \(h_s^{\star}=g_{sT}(z_0)\). Because every element of \(\mathcal B_s\) is at least \(b_{0s}=(Tn_s)^{-1/(2\lambda+d)}\vee N^{-1/2}\),
\[
(Tn_s(h_s^{\star})^d)^{-1/2}\le (h_s^{\star})^\lambda.
\]
Define
\[
R_D=\left\{\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s}\right\}\vee
\left[\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\left\{(h_s^{\star})^\lambda+(Tn_s(h_s^{\star})^d)^{-1/2}\right\}\right]^2\vee N^{-\kappa}.
\]
